verdict.rationale: Vanta explicitly markets auditor collaboration ('collaborate seamlessly with auditors...get audit-ready') and backs it with a dedicated Auditor API/SDKs that let auditors list audits, pull controls/evidence, manage Information Request Lists, and review in-scope resources directly in Vanta rather than via emailed PDFs. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation from actual auditors that they use this instead of email threads, and explicit UI description of the scoped auditor view.
